headline: HDFC Life Shares Jump 4% After IRDAI Panel Eases Commission-Cap Fears
summary: HDFC Life shares rose 4 percent as approximately 69.02 lakh shares changed hands following reports that an IRDAI panel recommended easing insurance commission-cap regulations.
why: Regulatory restrictions on agent commissions directly impact life insurance distribution economics and corporate profitability in India.

impacts.name: HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited
impacts.why: Relaxation of commission caps removes regulatory overhead, improving distribution flexibility and margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports that an insurance regulatory panel eased strict commission-cap fears drove strong buying in HDFC Life shares.
